text: Write a C function to split the given string with multiple delimiters by using regex.

args:
Forces of the 
darkness*are coming into the play.
test_cases.assert_src: assert multiple_split('Forces of the \ndarkness*are coming into the play.') == ['Forces of the ', 'darkness', 'are coming into the play.']

args:
Mi Box runs on the 
 Latest android*which has google assistance and chromecast.
expected: which has google assistance and chromecast.
test_cases.assert_src: assert multiple_split('Mi Box runs on the \n Latest android*which has google assistance and chromecast.') == ['Mi Box runs on the ', ' Latest android', 'which has google assistance and chromecast.']

args:
Certain services
are subjected to change*over the seperate subscriptions.
test_cases.assert_src: assert multiple_split('Certain services\nare subjected to change*over the seperate subscriptions.') == ['Certain services', 'are subjected to change', 'over the seperate subscriptions.']
